title: About Us
summary: Byblos Petroleum Company (BYPEC) S.A.R.L is a leading trading company, distributing and storing various petroleum lubricants products.
content:
Who are we?

Byblos Petroleum Company (BYPEC) S.A.R.L is a leading trading company, distributing and storing various petroleum lubricants products. We offer wholesale Diesel, fuel, oil and other petroleum products to both residential and commercial establishments.

By distributing quality brands we have gained good market share and we credit our success to our loyal customers and to our experienced and dedicated staff striving to provide our clients with exceptional service, quick response times and rapid on time deliveries.

We've got the market covered

BYPEC provides its services to local and international markets, expanding to supplying ships and boats with fuel oil products.

We distribute to Hotels, Hospitals, Schools, Resorts and Construction sites. If it has a tank and you want it filled we'll reach it.

Because we only distribute quality products, our customers can trust the source and authenticity of our supplies.

Brief History

BYPEC was established in 1998 by Pierre Issa as a petroleum distribution company and has grown and expended to establish its first gas station in Jeita in 2003,and three gas stations to follow in Byblos 2007 and in Amchit in 2011 and 2018.

Our Goal

We strive to continue providing an excellent service to our clients, exceeding their expectations and gaining their trust and be a major provider in the distribution of quality products in Lebanon while providing our staff with an excellent and enjoyable work environment.

We're looking forward to establish partnerships with leading companies and invest in new gas stations in order to grow with and evolve the industry.

Our Products

We distribute most petroleum products from Diesel, Gasoline( 95&98), Lubes, Fuel and Kaz.

For any other information don't hesitate to contacts us.

title: Services
summary: Our company has six distribution trucks of various sizes that cover different terrains and are able to reach almost all remote destinations.
content:
Petroleum Distribution

Our company has six distribution trucks of various sizes that cover different terrains and are able to reach almost all remote destinations. We distribute every petroleum lubricant available in the local market such as:

Unleaded Gasoline 95 Ron and super Unleaded Gasoline 98 Ron, Fuel oil, Diesel, Kerosene and motor oils of different grades for both diesel and gasoline engines.

All of our truck tanks and meter counters are stamped and controlled by the Ministry of Energy and Water in Lebanon and are regularly monitored by our staff to anticipate any inconvenience that might occur.

We are available on weekdays from 8 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 1 PM. Call us and make your order and it will be delivered to you on time.

Gas Stations Services

Car wash

All of our stations are equipped with quality washing products and skilled staff to ensure efficiency and satisfaction of our customers. In addition, air conditioned cafeterias are available at our stations where clients can enjoy a cool breeze and their favorite beverage while watching their vehicle.

Laser Car Wash

Limited to Amchit Station, we offer our Hands-free state of the art automatic car wash for fast and high quality delivery. You can check our Laser Car Wash at Amchit Station section for more details.

Carpet Wash

Full carpet wash - Our staff handles most modern cars and makes sure no harm is done to the interior and the electronics of your vehicle. Appointment is necessary, the process usually takes 2 to 3 hours but the carpet will need a full day with plenty of sunlight to dry out.

Truck Wash

Limited to Amchit station, we handle most trucks and dozers available in the local market, we also offer greasing and lube change services for trucks.

Lube Change

Bypec offers high quality British Petroleum Oils (BP) of different grades and functionalities. All of our Stations are equipped with various Oil Filters for most local vehicles. For more Info on BP lubes you can check their website www.bp.com or check our gas stations’ descriptions and images.

Of course, all standard services of gas stations are also available such as unleaded gasoline 95/98, fuel oil, Diesel, Gaz and Kaz tanks, various lubes and lubricants and a variety of fresheners and windshields.

All of our products and equipment follow the regulations and rules imposed by the Lebanese Government and are regularly monitored and checked by our Staff.

All of our Gas Stations are available 24/7, Car Wash closes at 8 PM.

For additional information about our services, or following any inconvenience at our Company or Stations please do not hesitate to leave your comment or contact us and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Amchit
summary: This is our third gas station. It is equipped with the latest equipment in the market and delivers a wide variety of services like laser car wash and truck wash, lube change, and of course related petroleum lubricants.
content:
Welcome to our Amchit station

This is our third gas station. It is equipped with the latest equipment in the market and delivers a wide variety of services like laser car wash and truck wash, lube change, and of course related petroleum lubricants.
​
Main entrance leaving Amchit towards the south highway.

We have both manual and laser (Hands-free) car wash.

Our Mark VII AquaJet XT 300 pioneered the touch-free, gantry-style automatic car wash. It is equipped with high pressure turbo technology that provides unparalleled cleaning power while minimizing the amount of power, chemicals and electricity consumed. It is also mounted with Presoak nozzles on the top boom, sides and bottom. the top boom lowers completely in the front and back of the vehicle while the sides and bottom nozzles clean the rest for enhanced coverage. It finishes with the triple foam conditioner used to enhance the cleaning process and the premium wax system, which provides extended protection for all vehicle surfaces. On the left side we have the manual car wash that deals with Lube Change, Greasing, Engine and undercarriage wash. We deliver high quality BP (British Petroleum) Oils for lube change and Oil Filters for almost every vehicle. You can check the picture below or contact us for additional information.

In addition, our crew handles car carpet cleaning with premium products. The process usually takes 2-3 hours to be completed, but the vehicle will take about 6 hours in the sun to dry completely. You can call us for appointments if you are interested.

Bypec Station delivers high quality truck and engine wash, lube change and greasing. We handle a variety of vehicles from Vans, Busses, Pickups, Trucks and loaders.

Our station has a market where people can rest and watch their cars being washed while enjoying their favorite beverage or doing their daily shopping.

We offer the usual petroleum products available in the market from Unleaded Gasoline 95 RON to super Unleaded Gasoline 98 RON, Fuel Oil and Diesel, Gaz tanks, Kaz and a variety of lubes to suit all of your vehicle’s needs. All of our petroleum products are clean and of premium quality, and are delivered to our stations by our company trucks only. Also, we ensure our lubricants meets all regulations and rules imposed by the government.

Windshields and car gadgets are also available in all of our stations in order to deliver the best services to our customers and make sure they feel comfortable and satisfied.

We would love to have you visit us, see our state-of-the-art services for yourself!

title: Byblos
summary: This is our second gas station, it was established in 2007 with Bypec's main office on top of it. Managed and supervised by the Chairman and staff, our station has grown to seize a significant market share in the city of Byblos.
content:
WELCOME TO OUR BYBLOS STATION

This is our second gas station, it was established in 2007 with Bypec's main office on top of it. Managed and supervised by the Chairman and staff, our station has grown to seize a significant market share in the city of Byblos. Like the rest of our establishments, Jbeil station offers a variety of petroleum products and an exceptional car wash staff ready to make your vehicle clean as new.

Two manual car washes located at the back entrance. We offer engine, undercarriage, carpet and regular wash and of course lube change for all kind of cars. Oil Filters and British Petroleum (BP) oils of various grades to fit old and modern vehicles. If the above picture wasn't useful and you need help with what oil suits your car best we are here for you, email us or contact us for additional information.

We provide our customers with high-quality petroleum lubricants such as Unleaded Gasoline 95 RON, super Unleaded Gasoline 98 RON, Fuel Oil, Diesel, Gaz tanks, Kaz Gallons and the usual Oils lubricants from monograde ( 30, 40 and 50 ), multigrade (10/40, 20/50, 40/50 ...) to full synthetic (5/40, 5/30). We also have Hydraulic 68 pails for trucks and Oil pails for Diesel engines and Generators.

Our products are regularly tested and monitored by our staff to anticipate any inconvenience that might occur. If you encountered any sort of trouble at our stations or have any comments, don't be shy to leave us your feedback or contact us.

All of our stations are at your service 24/7. Come visit us, try our services for yourself.

title: Amchit North Entrance
summary: Fourth Bypec gas station, established in 2018, Constructed and designed to meet modern day high quality standards. Located at Amchit north entrance and managed exclusively by the company itself.
content:
WELCOME TO OUR SECOND AMCHIT STATION

Fourth Bypec gas station, established in 2018, Constructed and designed to meet modern day high quality standards. Located at Amchit north entrance and managed exclusively by the company itself.

Despite being restricted by the small surface of the premises, Bypec managed to provide the station with the standard services available in the local market such as Unleaded 95 and super Unleaded 98 gasoline, Diesel, Kerosene, Oil lubricants of different grades and a luxurious touch-free car wash and lube change.

We offer high quality British Petroleum (BP) oils for lube change and Oil filters for the majority of vehicles. Check the picture above for more info on BP products.

Two manual car washes located under the station with a specialized staff ready to clean the hardest stains off your vehicle and provide you with a pleasurable experience that satisfies your taste.

We're waiting for you, give us a visit, try our service and you won't be disappointed .
